title: Mitochondrial DNA Abnormalities in Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathies: Innate Immune Signaling and Therapeutic Prospects.
snippet: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) encodes essential components of oxidative phosphorylation and can stimulate innate immunity when released from mitochondria.
